questions.question: Provide sources and specific comparisons for the assessment of Russia’s and Felix Klein’s roles in the international reform movement. The English text attributes the position to Lankov and preserves the author’s argument.

questions.question: Verify historical institution names and appointments, department chronology and bibliographical titles. Confirm the English rendering of the two-class school without confusing it with two years of study.
